Name: ControllerZoom
Author: mauricioalvim
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Controller Zoom[/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=3]Bring zoom control within reach for controller players.[/size][/center]

[hr]

[b]Push the right thumbstick up or down to zoom in and out on the fly.[/b] Hold the cursor modifier (click the left stick by default) whenever you need the vanilla right-stick mouse cursor instead.

[list]
[*][b]Zoom with the right stick[/b] — no more opening the options menu every time you want to see more (or less) of the map.
[*][b]Made for big maps[/b] — especially handy for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], whose maps are far larger than vanilla.
[*][b]Keeps the mouse out of your way[/b] — before this mod, even a light brush against the right stick woke the mouse cursor mid-game and desynced your inputs. Now the mouse only appears when you deliberately hold [b]L3 + right analog stick[/b].
[/list]
[hr]

[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]

[table]
[tr][th]Action[/th][th]Control[/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Zoom in[/td][td]Push the right stick up[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Zoom out[/td][td]Push the right stick down[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Right stick as mouse cursor (vanilla)[/td][td]Hold L3 (left stick click) + move the right stick[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Reset zoom to 100%[/td][td]Unbound by default (bind [i]ResetZoom[/i] in config)[/td][/tr]
[/table]
By default the right stick always zooms, and holding the cursor modifier switches it to vanilla cursor mode. Enable [i]SwapModifierRole[/i] in the config if you'd rather [b]hold the modifier to zoom[/b] and keep the bare right stick as the mouse cursor.

Zooming is tuned for finesse: light deflection adjusts slowly, holding the stick ramps up speed, a response curve gives precise low-end control, and the world point under your cursor stays anchored while you zoom.

[hr]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+
[*]SMAPI 4.0+
[*]A gamepad with [b]Gamepad Controls[/b] enabled
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.
[*]Unzip this mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder so it lands at [i]Stardew Valley/Mods/ControllerZoom[/i].
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI (a [i]config.json[/i] is created on first run).
[*]Make sure [b]Options → Gamepad Controls[/b] is enabled.
[/list]
[hr]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

All settings are in [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder:

[table]
[tr][th]Setting[/th][th]Default[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr]
[tr][td][i]Enabled[/i][/td][td][center]true[/center][/td][td]Master switch.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]CursorModifier[/i][/td][td][center]LeftStick[/center][/td][td]Button held to use the right stick as the mouse cursor.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]SuppressModifierVanillaAction[/i][/td][td][center]true[/center][/td][td]Stop the modifier button's vanilla action.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]SwapModifierRole[/i][/td][td][center]false[/center][/td][td]Invert roles: hold modifier to zoom, bare stick moves cursor.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]MinZoom[/i][/td][td][center]0.5[/center][/td][td]Lowest zoom level.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]MaxZoom[/i][/td][td][center]2.0[/center][/td][td]Highest zoom level.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]ZoomSpeed[/i][/td][td][center]0.7[/center][/td][td]Base zoom speed while the stick is held.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]ResponseCurve[/i][/td][td][center]1.5[/center][/td][td]Stick deflection exponent (gentler fine control at higher values).[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]AccelerationFactor[/i][/td][td][center]2.5[/center][/td][td]Max zoom speed multiplier while holding.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]AccelerationTimeMs[/i][/td][td][center]600[/center][/td][td]Time to ramp up to full acceleration.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]Deadzone[/i][/td][td][center]0.25[/center][/td][td]Stick deflection required before zooming.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]InvertZoomDirection[/i][/td][td][center]false[/center][/td][td]Swap up/down zoom direction.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]ApplyIntervalMs[/i][/td][td][center]40[/center][/td][td]How often the zoom is applied.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]ZoomIncrement[/i][/td][td][center]0.01[/center][/td][td]Rounds the zoom level to even steps.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]AnchorCursorWhileZooming[/i][/td][td][center]true[/center][/td][td]Keep the view pivoted around the cursor while zooming.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]ZoomSound[/i][/td][td][center]drumkit6[/center][/td][td]Sound cue while zooming ([i]""[/i] to disable).[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]SoundEveryPercent[/i][/td][td][center]10[/center][/td][td]Play the sound each time zoom passes a multiple of this many percent.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]PersistZoom[/i][/td][td][center]true[/center][/td][td]Remember the zoom level between sessions.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][i]ResetZoom[/i][/td][td][center]unbound[/center][/td][td]Button to instantly reset zoom to 100%.[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ / SMAPI 4.0+.
[*]Works in single-player and split-screen multiplayer (per-screen zoom).
[*]No save edits — safe to install and uninstall anytime.
[/list]
